provenance.basalt_semantics: basalt-headers aa441ba3 include/basalt/calibration/calib_bias.hpp CalibAccelBias/CalibGyroBias::getCalibrated = raw + S*raw - bias
provenance.window_rule: non-overlapping window slots [t0+k*window_s, t0+(k+1)*window_s) cut on real timestamps; evaluable iff n >= min_window_samples AND span >= 0.8*window_s; qualify iff max|gyro_raw| < gyro_max_dps AND std|a_raw| < acc_std_max

direction_coverage.note: single gravity direction: per-axis scale and bias are NOT separable; multi-direction coverage is necessary (not sufficient) for any validation claim

conclusion_boundary: This tool checks ONLY that the calibrated accelerometer norm on quasi-static windows equals gravity; it is not a calibration, not a gate, and never validates a calibration.
A single observed gravity direction cannot separate per-axis scale from bias; multi-direction (e.g. six-orientation static) recordings are required for that.
CONSISTENT_ON_OBSERVED_WINDOWS_NOT_VALIDATED means: within the given threshold on the observed windows/orientations only.
It does not replace: six-orientation static IMU calibration, a B segment with strong translational excitation, or an independent retest with metric board PnP.
